$comment: Redacted schema snapshot captured from the live McDonald's MCP server (https://mcp.mcd.cn) on 2026-10-15 22:00 GMT+8. Captured with a real, authenticated, read-only session. No token, no personal data and no raw response bodies are stored here — only request schemas and response field shapes.

query-nearby-stores.purpose: Find a real store and obtain storeCode / beCode

beType.description: 1 = 到店自提 (no beCode returned), 5 = 得来速 (beCode required downstream)

searchType.description: 2 = search by location (city + keyword required), 1 = favourites

keyword.description: 位置关键词, required when searchType=2

query-nearby-stores.notes: MealScript stores only storeCode + storeName; address / distance / coordinates are dropped before the result reaches the UI or a fixture.

query-meals.purpose: Fetch the current sellable catalogue for a store

orderType.description: 1 = 到店 (自取/得来速), 2 = 外送

beCode.description: beType=1 (到店自取) must NOT pass beCode

query-meals.notes: Prices are strings in YUAN here (e.g. "33.5"). Product images are brand assets and are deliberately NOT copied into fixtures.

query-meal-detail.purpose: Verify a candidate's composition and customisation options

calculate-price.purpose: Official settlement price — the final authority for the budget check

items[].modification.values[]: code + key + quantity; selected items use selectedKey, unselected items use unselectedKey

calculate-price.critical: ALL money fields are in FEN (1/100 yuan). 2250 means CNY 22.50. Dividing by 100 is mandatory.

query-store-coupons.purpose: Coupon extension — price must be recalculated after applying a coupon

list-nutrition-foods.purpose: Nutrition extension — only for products with a reliable mapping

forbidden.create-order: Creates a real transaction. MealScript never calls this.
forbidden.auto-bind-coupons: Claims coupons on the user's account.
forbidden.mall-create-order: Paid order in the points mall.
